mentions.name: Printable habit-tracking grid (spreadsheet)
mentions.description: A personal spreadsheet-based habit-tracking grid for chronic pain management: days of the month across the top and the tasks to do along the side, tweaked and printed every month and carried in a discbound clipboard organizer to share and discuss with care providers.
mentions.problem: Managing chronic pain by tracking daily habits and tasks in a form that can be shared with care providers.
mentions.audience: The author managing their own chronic pain, with output shared and discussed with their care providers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also created a grid for habit tracking (for chronic pain mgmt). Day of month across the top, all the things I'm supposed to do along the side. Something to share and discuss with my care providers.

evidence.value: I also created a grid for habit tracking (for chronic pain mgmt). Day of month across the top, all the things I'm supposed to do along the side. Something to share and discuss with my care providers.
